comment: Which planted defects of bench/cases/analytics-service carry an executable probe. Three defects across three files, so each probe names its own source rather than the case declaring one. No patch ships for this case, so only the unpatched half of the cross-check runs and the harness says so.
minimum_isolation_why: These probes attach handlers to a logger and hold invented personal data in memory. Both belong to a process that ends when the measurement ends.

P-29.class: serializer returns every field of the model
P-29.what_the_probe_does: Serializes a customer carrying invented sensitive values and requires national_id, internal_risk_score and support_notes to appear in the dashboard response body.
P-29.control: `customer_response_public` serializes the same customer from a declared field list. A field that comes back from BOTH is not evidence of this defect, and the probe says so instead of reporting a finding.

P-30.class: personal data written to the application log
P-30.what_the_probe_does: Captures what the logger emits with a plain formatter attached and requires the email and the national id to be in the line.
P-30.why_the_plain_formatter: The case ships a `RedactingFormatter` and the probe deliberately does not install it for the finding. The defect is that the default path writes the data; a formatter somebody has to remember to attach is not a control that holds. Whether it redacts when it IS installed is measured separately and reported in the evidence, because that is a fact about the case worth carrying.
P-30.control: `log_request_redacted` logs the same request with an opaque identifier. Values present in both lines would mean the probe is reading the harness.

P-32.class: third-party tags loaded with no consent gate
P-32.what_the_probe_does: Asks for the tags and observes that the call has nowhere to put a consent decision at all.
P-32.control: `load_trackers_after_consent` takes the refusal and returns nothing. The finding stands only if the gated call honours a refusal and the shipped call cannot receive one.
P-32.why_this_is_weaker: Nothing happening is also what a broken probe looks like. The sibling is what separates the two.
